build_hadamard_transform: build a Hadamard transform instance using the factory function with a given hadamard_type string
create_HadamardTransform: create a deterministic block-diagonal Hadamard rotation module with a specified block size and device
create_RandomHadamardTransform: create a randomly signed Hadamard rotation module with a reproducible seed for the generator
run_HadamardTransform_forward: run the forward pass of a HadamardTransform on a tensor to apply the rotation
review_HADAMARDS: review the HADAMARDS registry dictionary that maps hadamard type strings to their transform classes
